luci-app-mesh.description: Grant access to Mesh 组网 (meshctl / uci mesh). hostapd.*: the connection-device page needs get_clients/get_status/list_bans (read) and del_client/bss_transition_request/rrm_beacon_req (write). Note: del_client is also granted by LuCI's own luci-mod-network/luci-mod-status-index, so it is duplicated here on purpose for systems that ship a trimmed LuCI.
